text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feeling thirsty, I decided to drop by a cafe.
Amidst the bustling crowd, I was finally called—

text_block_list.name: Cafe Waitress
text_block_list.text:
Kirarin♪ Welcomeee☆
Thank you for waiting! Just one person today?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! This shop is super cute, isn't it?!
I feel totally out of place here...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Do you think so? To me,
you seem to blend in quite well, you know?

text_block_list.name: Cafe Waitress
text_block_list.text:
To the two guests behind, I'm so sorryyy.
We are currently at full capacity, so...

text_block_list.name: Cafe Waitress
text_block_list.text:
Um... excuse me, customer, would you mind
sharing a table with them?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, Trainer-san from the Academy!
Really? That's a huge help!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
In that case, we shall gladly accept your
kind offer and join you.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Waitress
text_block_list.text:
☆
Alrighty, let me show you all to your tableee♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We took our seats, looked over the menu,
and were just about to order, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Um, for the drink... one Royal,
Mari... Marilyn?... please...

text_block_list.name: Cafe Waitress
text_block_list.text:
Yeees♪ One 『Royal☆Marilyn』!
Would you also like to try our limited-time sweet,
the 『Angel's Halo』, along with it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Eh...?! Ah, then I'll take that too... yeah.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Waitress
text_block_list.text:
♪ Oh, please choose your drink size
from Dolly, Prettie, or Charmie☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
P-Prettie? Charmie?
Umm, er...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Um... this is our first time visiting this cafe.
Could you perhaps explain what those mean?

text_block_list.name: Cafe Waitress
text_block_list.text:
Certainlyyy☆
Dolly is Small, Prettie is Medium, and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After getting an explanation for the unique naming scheme,
we somehow managed to order three drinks and one dessert...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Haha... I honestly didn't understand
even half of what she said...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Pheeew, finally we can relax.
I was completely flustered the whole time...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...I'm so glad you stayed calm, Ardan-san!
!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I am the one who should thank you.
Thanks to your invitation, Ryan, I was able
to experience such a humorous cafe.
choice_data_list: You two really get along well.
You two are close, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. We have seen each other at Mejiro family
gatherings since we were very young...
Even back then, Ryan was a very sweet girl.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Showing me games I didn't know, secret spots...
They are all wonderful memories.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! That really takes me back.
I was always so happy whenever you listened to
me talk like a big sister, Ardan-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course, I'm still super happy
whenever you listen to me talk even now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu... yes. If I am enough,
please feel free to talk to me anytime.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Waitress
text_block_list.text:
Kirarin♪ Thank you for waiting!
Here is your 『Royal☆Marilyn』
and the 『Angel's Halo』!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So this is... the Royal Marilyn.
...Oh, it's black tea.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
And this is the Angel's Halo...
It is quite a large baumkuchen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's practically the size of a whole cake!
Hmm, this is a pretty massive portion...
choice_data_list: If you two share it, you can finish it!
If you two split it, you'll easily eat it all!
Do you want to get it to-go?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's practically the size of a whole cake!
Hmm, this is a pretty massive portion...
choice_data_list: If you two share it, you can finish it!
If you two split it, you'll easily eat it all!
Do you want to get it to-go?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Let us cut it up and split it
in half between Ryan and myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan cut the baumkuchen skillfully and
without making a sound, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Oh dear, the portions ended up uneven.
Well then, the larger piece goes to Ryan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No way, you're the one who cut it, Ardan-san,
so you should eat the bigger one!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, please don't be shy.
I want to act like a proper older sister today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I know, why don't I cut it into
easy-to-eat bite-sized pieces for you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wa—!
...Ugh, my face is starting to feel all hot...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, happily sharing the baumkuchen,
the two of them managed to finish it all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's just enjoy the black tea!
Look, it looks delicious!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My... the aroma of this black tea is very pure.
Could it be single-estate tea leaves?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You can tell all that just from the scent?
...Between you and Dober, knowing so much
about black tea shows how cultured you both are.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It is simply because I love it. When it comes to
muscles, Ryan, your knowledge is far deeper than mine, no?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's true... Ah, there's a workout
you can do right now while sitting down!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's called the 『Seated Calf Raise』,
and it targets the soleus muscle—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: My goodness... ufufu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While lively conversations bloomed across various topics,
they were able to thoroughly savor their tea.
